on.label: On
on.desc: Quick-save from the popup shows the matching rule's folder — pick a different one if needed, then save.

off.label: Off
off.desc: Regular browser bookmarks — the extension doesn't interfere.

mainTab.lead: Determines what happens when you add a bookmark. Change it here or right in the popup.

rulesTab.lead: Checked top to bottom — the first match wins.

conditionRow.errorValuesRequired: at least one value is required

searchTab.lead: Searches by title, URL, and folder among already sorted bookmarks.
searchTab.noResults: Nothing found — try a different query.

aliasesTab.lead: Domain aliases, extraction variables, and backups.

aliasesSection.title: Domain aliases
aliasesSection.desc: One alias for multiple domains — e.g. regional mirrors.

tagsTab.lead: Tags for bookmarks — name and color. Assigning tags to bookmarks and searching by them are coming separately.

tagsSection.title: Tags
tagsSection.desc: The list of tags with a color. Definitions only for now — assigning a tag to a bookmark comes later.

variablesSection.title: Variables
variablesSection.desc: Alias fields for paths in the page's HTML tree. Used in rules and export.

exportSection.title: Export / Import
exportSection.desc: A single-file backup of all rules, aliases, and variables.
exportSection.importError: Couldn't import the file — check its format.
exportSection.importSuccessDesc: Rules, aliases, and variables were updated.

defaultFolderSection.title: Default folder
defaultFolderSection.desc: Where quick-save pre-selects a bookmark when no rule matches. Leave empty for the Bookmarks Bar.

quickSave.title: Quick save
quickSave.offNote: Quick save is off — "Off" mode doesn't touch bookmarks.
